method: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Peel and cut the potatoes into even 2cm chunks. Boil for 15–20 minutes until a knife goes through easily, then drain and mash with 2–3 tablespoons of the hot cooking water; no milk or butter is added.
Dice the carrots finely. Measure the medium curry sauce ready to add near the end of cooking.

Heat half the measured olive oil in a non-stick frying pan. Pat the firm tofu dry, cut into 2cm cubes and cook over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, turning until the edges are golden and the middle is hot. Transfer the cooked filling to a clean plate.

Add the remaining measured olive oil, carrots and 60ml water to the pan. Cover and simmer gently for 8–10 minutes until the carrots soften; add the peas for the final 3 minutes and cook until piping hot. Add a spoonful of water if the pan dries before the carrots are tender.
Return the cooked filling to the vegetables. Stir in the medium curry sauce, heat for 1–2 minutes, then spoon into a small ovenproof dish.

Spread the mashed potato over the filling and roughen the top with a fork. Bake for 15–20 minutes, until the top colours and the centre of the pie is steaming hot. Rest for 2 minutes. Serve while hot.
